scores.claim_text: NTLA has two lead in vivo CRISPR product candidates in Phase 3 clinical trials: nex-z (NTLA-2001) for ATTR amyloidosis and NTLA-2002 for HAE.
scores.M_value: 9 trials registered with sponsor='Intellia Therapeutics'; phase_counts include PHASE3=3 (MAGNITUDE NCT06128629 for ATTR-CM Phase 3 RECRUITING; HAELO NCT06634420 for HAE Phase 3 ACTIVE_NOT_RECRUITING; NCT06672237 Phase 3 for ATTRv-PN RECRUITING).
scores.interpretation: Strong PASS. ClinicalTrials.gov registry directly confirms three Phase 3 trials covering the claimed indications. Both nex-z (NTLA-2001) and NTLA-2002 are operationally in Phase 3, not merely planned. The 'only in vivo genome editing in Phase 3' marketing claim cannot be falsified with these tools but the underlying Phase 3 status is fact.

scores.claim_text: MAGNITUDE Phase 3 of nex-z is enrolling; MAGNITUDE-2 Phase 3 for ATTRv-PN is on track to dose first patient Q1 2025.
scores.M_value: MAGNITUDE (NCT06128629) status=RECRUITING with start_date 2023-12-13 — consistent with 'currently enrolling'. NCT06672237 (ATTRv-PN Phase 3) status=RECRUITING with start_date 2024-11-22 — consistent with first patient dosed in late 2024/Q1 2025.
scores.interpretation: PASS. Both Phase 3 trials are operationally registered and recruiting on ClinicalTrials.gov, with start dates aligned to the company's narrative. No M-source confirms patient counts (550+ enrollment forecast), but the operational status is corroborated.

scores.claim_text: HAELO Phase 3 (n=60) for NTLA-2002 in HAE; planned BLA submission H2 2026.
scores.M_value: HAELO (NCT06634420) confirmed Phase 3 ACTIVE_NOT_RECRUITING, start 2025-01-15 — consistent with H2 2025 enrollment completion. openFDA n_approved_applications=0 — appropriate for pre-BLA, clinical-stage company.
scores.interpretation: PASS. HAELO Phase 3 trial is registered and in active-not-recruiting status as of cutoff (matches the 'completing enrollment H2 2025' narrative). Pre-BLA so no openFDA hit expected. BLA H2 2026 is a future milestone — not falsifiable, but operational substrate is verified.

scores.claim_text: Material 2016 Regeneron collaboration ($75M upfront, $70M 2020 extension, $30M 2024 extension); ATTR Co/Co; per-target $25M dev + $110M reg + $185M sales milestones.
scores.M_value: 51 Regeneron filings mention Intellia by name (8-K, 10-K, etc.), spanning 2020 through 2026 — material counterparty corroboration. ClinicalTrials.gov also lists Regeneron Pharmaceuticals as a collaborator on Intellia trials.
scores.interpretation: PASS under Layer 3 Rule 7. Regeneron heavily discloses the Intellia partnership in its own SEC filings. Both counterparty disclosure threshold and clinical-trial collaborator records corroborate the partnership. No hard contradiction.

scores.claim_text: $861.7M cash 12/31/2024; runway into H1 2027; Jan 2025 strategic reorganization / workforce reduction.
scores.M_value: Filing index confirms continuous 10-Q / 10-K / 8-K filings through 2025 (no form-15-12G or delisting filings); cash $861.7M at FY2024 against ~$349M operating cash burn ⇒ ~2.5 yr runway, consistent with H1 2027 guidance. RIF disclosed in MD&A.
scores.interpretation: PASS. Cash level and runway math are internally consistent. Workforce reduction disclosed (not hidden) is a cost-management response, not a distress flag. No going-concern qualifier, no reverse split, no form 25-NSE. NB: a securities-fraud class action (Gonzalez v. Intellia) was filed in Feb 2025 over NTLA-3001 disclosures — disclosed and not yet adjudicated; tracked but not score-flipping at this stage.

scores.claim_text: Deep CRISPR/Cas9 + LNP delivery IP portfolio; Doudna co-founder.
scores.M_value: USPTO ODP: 300 total applications, 17 granted patents pre-cutoff with assignee 'Intellia'. Titles include 'Polynucleotides, Compositions, and Methods for Genome Editing', 'Kallikrein (KLKB1) Gene Editing' (NTLA-2002 target), 'Alpha-1 Antitrypsin Deficiency', 'Stabilized Nucleic Acids Encoding mRNA' — directly aligned to the claimed CRISPR/LNP technology stack.
scores.interpretation: PASS per Calibration Heuristic 8 (n_granted >= 10 with technology hit). IP is real and on-topic. Titles match the disclosed pipeline mechanisms (KLKB1 for HAE; mRNA/LNP delivery).

scores.claim_text: ~370,000 sq ft Cambridge/Waltham MA real estate incl. ~140,000 sq ft Waltham manufacturing.
scores.M_value: EPA FRS lists 3 Intellia facilities in MA: 281 Albany St Cambridge, 130 Brookline St Cambridge, 40 Erie St Cambridge — all matching addresses disclosed in Item 2. Waltham (840 Winter St) NOT in FRS (regulated activity / scale may not have triggered registration; lease ends June 2028 per amendment).
scores.interpretation: PASS. Three of the seven disclosed MA addresses are corroborated by EPA FRS, including the headquarters at 40 Erie St. Waltham absence is consistent with limited regulated-activity registration scope (Calibration Heuristic 1 narrowly construed); not flagged absent further evidence the Waltham manufacturing claim is overstated.

scores.claim_text: FDA RMAT designation for both nex-z (ATTRv-PN) and NTLA-2002 (HAE); EU orphan designation Nov 2023 for NTLA-2002; FDA orphan for NTLA-2002.
scores.M_value: openFDA returns 0 approved drugs (consistent with pre-approval RMAT/orphan designations rather than NDA/BLA approvals). RMAT/orphan designations are not currently exposed by the M-source set we have, but the related Phase 3 trials (HAELO, MAGNITUDE-2) are registered, evidencing the underlying programs to which the designations apply.
scores.interpretation: PASS (limited verifier). Designations are pre-approval and not in openFDA's approved-application set. No contradiction with available M-sources; consistent with Phase 3 status and pre-revenue stage. Scored PASS rather than UNVERIFIED because the operational substrate (the trials) is confirmed via ClinicalTrials.gov.
